lineage.change_reason: CP188 proved the per-graph resource protocol on the resident 32B, then was stopped before a second optimizer step because its v2 checkpoint omitted pending telemetry windows and holdout rotation. CP189 restarts from the base under checkpoint v3 and independently preserves exact pre-resume evidence.

training.execution_shape_rationale: Four slots and two branch roles match the resident interactive profile; curriculum depth four exceeds the live two-step profile so added recurrence must learn a positive contribution.

memory_safety.rule: Every graph retains the CP188 external lease. Checkpoint v3 must additionally preserve all pending loss/cosine windows, committed holdout history, and holdout rotation so partial plus resume is evidence-schedule-equivalent to uninterrupted execution.

requirements: training_completion complete OR halt wall_clock with >= 200 steps
finite loss trail and finite holdout trail
strict v2 identity contract validates objective v3, with explicit non-load-eligible scope for any bounded partial
holdout mean CE at final checkpoint not worse than 1.5x its minimum
complete startup-steady-compute-draining stage evidence below active ceilings for both phases
contiguous create-once compute-lease hash chain with exact trainer PID, sentinel PID, workload, sequence, request, acknowledgement, and low-water rearm bindings
checkpoint schema v3 with exact pending loss/cosine and holdout rotation state
create-once pre-resume attestation binds the partial receipt, checkpoint completion record, and adapter/optimizer tensor bytes before resume launch
partial shutdown telemetry is receipt-only projection and does not mutate resumable evidence state
mechanical_admission.on_failure: REFUTED-mechanics; no freeze or evaluation compute for the adapter

post_training_pilot.decode: contract-aware termination with decode_max_tokens 768 uniformly across every arm; automatically staged only after admission, immutable freeze, and resident mechanics pass
advance_only_if: adapter_vanilla has no material regression against base_vanilla
adapter-RLC branch scores are not all tied
ordinary-generation isolation exact; all identity receipts validate
post_training_pilot.negative_or_inconclusive_action: diagnose, revise training, preregister a fresh pilot; do not run or claim the confirmatory campaign

required_controls: externally held task and provider trust roots
signed zero-overlap contamination audit against exact training corpus
